<p dir="auto">This project transforms the <strong>Global Superstore</strong> dataset into a fully interactive, production-grade Power BI dashboard. It goes beyond basic charts — featuring <strong>Drillthrough pages</strong>, <strong>Tooltip pages</strong>, <strong>YoY KPI comparisons</strong>, and <strong>advanced visualizations</strong> such as Sankey diagrams, Sunburst charts, and animated Bar Chart Races.</p>
<p dir="auto">The dashboard is structured into <strong>3 analytical dimensions</strong> (Product, Customer, Region), each with dedicated slicers, KPIs, and visualizations, connected through a seamless navigation system.</p>
